evaluation.results_summary: As of February 25, 2025, the model is reported as the highest-scoring 14B model on IFEval.

identity.name: ZYH-LLM-Qwen2.5-14B-V3
identity.summary: A 14-billion-parameter model built through extensive model merging, intended as a strong foundation for further merging and fine-tuning.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Text-generation model with no reported factual grounding or evaluation beyond IFEval, so it can produce factually inaccurate content.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,531,962,384 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a merge created with the model_stock merge method, combining four Qwen2.5-14B-YOYO-della variants with the ZYH-LLM-Qwen2.5-14B-V3-preview base model. The merge uses bfloat16 precision, int8 mask, and normalization.
